notes: The benchmark's LLM judge. It is a property of the benchmark, not of the arm under test: every arm is scored by the same judge, or the scores are not comparable. Override per run with ADHERENCE_JUDGE_MODEL / ADHERENCE_JUDGE_PROVIDER / ADHERENCE_JUDGE_BASE_URL, or per arm with judge_model / judge_provider / judge_base_url in that arm's config. Changing this invalidates comparison with results produced under a different judge.
